exercises.instructionEn: Irregular Verbs: Infinitive - Past - Past Participle.
exercises.explanationUz:
NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR - 3 ShAKL.

  1-shakl (Infinitive): hozirgi,
    to + fe'l
  2-shakl (Past): Past Simple
  3-shakl (Past Participle):
    Present/Past Perfect, Passiv

  UChALASI BIR XIL (12 ta):
    burst, cost, cut, hit, hurt, let, put, read, set, shut, split, spread

  2 va 3 BIR XIL (52 ta):
    bring, build, burn, buy, catch, deal, dig, dream, feed, feel, fight, find, get, hang, have, hear, hold, keep, lay, lead, learn, leave, lend, light, lose, make, mean, meet, pay, say, seek, sell, send, shine, shoot, sit, sleep, smell, spell, spend, spill, spoil, stand, stick, sting, strike, sweep, teach, tell, think, understand, win

  QOLGANLARI - UChALASI HAR XIL:
    be-was-been, go-went-gone,
    write-wrote-written ...

  ⚠ Qavsdagi shakl (burned,
  dreamed, learned, smelled,
  spelled, spoiled, hanged) -
  muntazam -ed shakli, u ham
  to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'hanged' - faqat 'osib
  o'ldirmoq' ma'nosida.
  ⚠ 'read' - yozilishi bir xil,
  o'qilishi har xil: /ri:d/ -
  /red/ - /red/.
  ⚠ 'lie' (yotmoq) - lay - lain;
  'lay' (qo'ymoq) - laid - laid.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the Past and Past Participle forms of the verbs.
exercises.explanationUz:
3 ShAKLNI YOD OLING.

  Har fe'l uchun ikki bo'shliq:
  1-bo'shliq - Past (2-shakl),
  2-bo'shliq - Past Participle
  (3-shakl).

  ⚠ Qavsli muntazam shakllar
  (burned, learned ...) ham qabul
  qilinadi, lekin jadvaldagi
  asosiy shaklni yozing.

items.whyUz: ⚠ burn - burnt - burnt (yonmoq, kuydirmoq). 'burned' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ can - could; 3-shakli yo'q, o'rniga 'been able to'.
⚠ dream - dreamt - dreamt (tush ko'rmoq, orzu qilmoq). 'dreamed' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ hang - hung - hung (osmoq). 'hanged' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ learn - learnt - learnt (o'rganmoq). 'learned' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ smell - smelt - smelt (hidlamoq). 'smelled' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ spell - spelt - spelt (harflab aytmoq). 'spelled' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).
⚠ spoil - spoilt - spoilt (buzmoq). 'spoiled' ham to'g'ri (muntazam shakl).

patterns.exampleEn: She went to Rome last year. He wrote a letter.
patterns.exampleUz: U o'tgan yili Rimga bordi. U xat yozdi.

patterns.exampleEn: I have never been to Cairo. She has written three books.
patterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon Qohirada bo'lmaganman. U uchta kitob yozgan.

patterns.exampleEn: This song was written by Frank Sinatra. The window was broken.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qo'shiq Frenk Sinatra tomonidan yozilgan. Deraza sindirilgan.

patterns.exampleEn: He had finished by the time I called.
patterns.exampleUz: Men qo'ng'iroq qilgunimcha u tugatgan edi.
